title: pr land checks the PR state after a merge call that fails
notes: Seen 2026-11-16: `pr land 301` printed 'gh refused to merge 301 ...: Post https://api.github.com/graphql: unexpected EOF', but the PR had merged. The merge went through and only the response was lost. When gh pr merge fails, read the PR's state: if it is MERGED at the noted head commit, report merged. Otherwise retry once on an API/network error, and refuse on a real refusal. Test the decision. Do not bump the version.

comments.body: From main-dashboard: build the fix at the root, with a test for the decision. Tests must be Windows-safe (path.join, or a win32 guard). Run pnpm test, typecheck and lint. If the card references a GitHub issue, the PR says 'Closes #N'. Do not bump the version.
